description:
About the Position

This experimental PhD examines how carbon dioxide changes directly from gas to solid at cryogenic temperatures. The research supports design approaches for carbon-capture systems that do not rely on chemical solvents.

Research Position Overview

Build a controlled test rig, observe solid-layer growth with optical diagnostics and analyse heat and mass transfer. The project combines laboratory experiments, modelling and quantitative data analysis.

Research Areas

  • Cryogenic carbon capture
  • CO₂ phase change
  • Optical diagnostics and heat transfer
